name: Roberto Mangual
headline: Chairman & CEO | Avantex | Driving global innovation in AI-powered enterprise software for Fashion, Apparel and Textiles

experiences.description: Oversaw Aptean’s discrete manufacturing portfolio in the Americas—spanning apparel, industrial manufacturing, and related sectors—while leading the division’s sales, service, and support teams.

•	After managing operations for the prior 4 years, promoted to take on the added responsibility for Simparel’s R&D, sales and marketing, customer service, all business processes, P&L and set the company Vision and supporting strategies to lead Simparel into the future.

•	Took the helm of the company as it was burning $500k per quarter for multiple consecutive quarters and led the company to profitability within 90 days and led the company to record top and bottom line results 2 consecutive years.

•	Responsible for all business operations including Professional Services, Client Development, Pre-Sales, Implementation and Post-Implementation Support.

•	Implemented the “Proven Path” implementation methodology across the professional services organization resulting in reduced client costs, improved services and an industry leading 95% customer satisfaction rating – and improvement of 90%!.
